title: Sidecar check
author: Iced-Cream
description: A test for core-a4mk2's moments, the calls the Sidecar companion uses, checked in RAM: sidecar-check-ar2's part 3 on the Analog Four MKII, after the magic SCK3. A SysEx handler that takes F0 7D messages and lets the rest through, USB MIDI through core_midi_try_send from the UI task and from the audio interrupt, the current kit, track, pattern and project name each tick, the name at ev_project_save, three handle fields walked by core_handle_fields, and every ev_kit logged. Over USB MIDI, F0 7D 53 43 SysEx commands set the command word and send the record back.
